ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. jobs.title: Senior People Operations Manager
jobs.description: Rethink what People Ops can do with AI. We’re looking for someone who sees opportunities to work smarter, challenges how things have always been done, and uses AI and automation to solve real operational problems as we scale. As a senior individual contributor, you’ll own initiatives end to end, combining practical People Operations expertise with the ability to build smarter, more automated ways of working across the employee lifecycle. The job Taptap Send is growing, with hubs in London, Paris, New York, Dubai and Morocco. You'll shape how its People function scales internationally. Open new countries for hiring: take a jurisdiction from entity and payroll set-up through contracts, benefits and local compliance, so the business can hire there cleanly. Own employee relations: sensitive cases, performance processes and investigations, working closely with Legal. The calls that need the most care are yours. Automate payroll, then keep going: build payroll into a streamlined, automated operation across markets, then apply the same thinking to onboarding, offboarding and contractor management. Keep every market compliant: stay aligned with local labour law as the business operates and expands. Land projects end to end: scope, drive and deliver improvements to how the function runs, using people data and automation to make processes more efficient, consistent and scalable. Why you'll want it Put AI and automation into practice. Go beyond using AI to write emails or summarise documents. Build workflows, automate repetitive processes and find practical ways to eliminate manual work across People Operations. Build from scratch, more than once. Each new jurisdiction is a fresh build: entity, payroll, contracts, benefits. Stay hands-on at senior level. You set the approach and see it through yourself. Als Talent Acquisition Intern bist du das operative Rückgrat unseres Talent-Teams und sorgst mit uns dafür, dass die richtigen Menschen zu trawa finden. Du hältst unsere Prozesse am Laufen, gestaltest reibungslose Candidate Journeys, räumst administrative Hürden aus dem Weg und hilfst, ein Hiring-Erlebnis zu bauen, das hängen bleibt. So bringst du direkt mit voran, was uns antreibt: Unternehmen den Zugang zu echter, grüner Energie zu ermöglichen. Diese Rolle passt perfekt zu dir, wenn du Talent Acquisition hands-on lernen willst, gerne mit modernen Tools und KI-Lösungen arbeitest und direkt sehen möchtest, wie dein Beitrag das gesamte Team schneller und besser macht. Bei uns findest du keine starren Strukturen - dafür Gestaltungsspielraum, Vertrauen und ein Team, das die Energiewende gemeinsam voranbringt. Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen! jobs.title: Recruiter, Commercial
jobs.description: About Andercore Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry. Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell. We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought. We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded. Where we are today: Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW The margin is in the bits. jobs.description: The Organization & Employee Development Intern will support the HR team in employee engagement activities, training and development, and organization development. The role involves assisting with planning, coordination, documentation, and program support while gaining practical experience in HR operations and communication. Core Responsibilities: Documentation & Logistics Support: Assist in preparing HR program materials, coordinating event logistics, maintaining accurate records, organizing files, and communicating schedules and requirements to participants. Program Implementation Support: Support the execution of employee engagement and development activities by facilitating sessions, assisting speakers, monitoring program delivery, collecting feedback, and ensuring smooth event operations. Event Proposal Development: Help conceptualize and prepare employee engagement event proposals, conduct research, collaborate with stakeholders, create multimedia materials for internal communications, and develop a comprehensive event proposal from planning through execution.
